title: lantana involucrata var. odorata
intro: Lantana involucrata var. odorata, commonly known as Fragrant Lantana, is a shrub-like plant belonging to the Verbenaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Fragrant Lantana include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress and microbial infections. The bioactive constituents of Fragrant Lantana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
